Context: 6. Petitions to President

1. Form and manner of petition.The petition (which includes a memorial, representation, letter or an application of the nature of a petition) should be (i) legible preferably in typescript or print, (ii) signed by the petitioner, and (iii) in the official language of the Union or any of the regional languages specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution. If the petition or enclosures are in regional languages, a translated copy in English or Hindi should be furnished.
